result.title: RGB--Event Object Detection Across Operating Frequencies via Reliability-Supervised Routing and Asymmetric-Resolution Fusion
result.summary: Autonomous vehicles must detect objects faster than a frame camera delivers images. Event cameras record brightness changes with microsecond resolution, so RGB--event detectors can decide between frames, at an operating frequency, the rate of decisions, far above the frame rate. As this rate rises, each decision receives a sparser event window, and the reliability of the events relative to the frame varies over the scene and over time. Existing detectors weight the sensors per sample and encode the frame at the reduced event resolution. Reliability-supervised routing assigns a fusion weight to every location and supervises it with targets from the losses of two single-modality classifiers used only in training, moving loss-based supervision of fusion weights from whole samples to individual locations. Asymmetric-resolution fusion lets the frame carry the decision where the events fail: it encodes the frame at native resolution and pools every feature level onto the event grid, reusing all pretrained weights. On the DSEC-Det dataset, routing halves the accuracy loss from 20 to 180 Hz, from 6.3 to 3.1 mAP, and lowers it in every seed. The resulting detector, ERA-Det, sets a new state of the art at 63.2 mAP, 3.7 mAP above FlexEvent, leads at every operating frequency, and at 180 Hz is more accurate than FlexEvent at 20 Hz. On two DAVIS346 datasets, the router lowers the frame weight at night and in low light and raises it when the events vanish. ERA-Det upgrades released FlexEvent weights in 5,000 iterations on one GPU.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 RGB–事件相机跨工作频率的目标检测，提出可靠性监督路由（用仅训练时使用的两个单模态分类器损失，为每个位置生成融合权重监督信号）与非对称分辨率融合（帧保持原生分辨率、各级特征池化到事件网格），在 DSEC-Det 与 DAVIS346 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐位置可信度加权、用训练期辅助监督为融合权重分配贡献、以及保留帧原生分辨率再对齐到事件网格，可能可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、贡献分配与「细节不被压缩掉」的表示设计；但该文属检测期多模态融合，与 VLM 内部 latent 状态生成的迁移性仍需核查。
